items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: David Stone Martin - you remember him? - he came here... He sat with me all night.

ctx.x: When Norman Granz arranged the concert with the- was it the New York Philharmonic?

Yes, the Philharmonic, I didn't finish that. Milton Great Arendt was helping me with the arrangements. There was four of the "Zodiac Suite". So he had a gig coming up Saturday that he had forgotten about. It was an important gig, like he was the leader, and he had to go up in the country to play bass. So he said, "Pussy Cat" - that was my nickname then - "I can't finish the arrangements." I said, "Oh, goodness, I'll finish them myself." I did "Scorpio". He was so surprised.
